_note: A4 Hero Oaths (Ömer seçimi 2026-10-25, maps-2-3.md 9; Ömer notu: TEK tapınak, TEK kahraman). Tapınak: Saltspray Shrine (dr52, oathShrine). Aynı anda yalnız bir kahraman yeminli; yemin kalıcı bir artı + kalıcı bir eksi. Bozmak breakCost altın (yalnız tapınakta). Kayıtta CampaignState.oath, haritalar arası taşınır. Etki alanları: damageAdd / critAdd (savaş kurulumu, UnitModifiers ile toplanır), hpMult (çarpılır), restHealMult (kamp Rest + Inn günlük şifası), victoryHealMult (zafer şifası). Sayılar PROVİZYON (open-questions 429).
text: The spray never stops at the Saltspray Shrine. Sailors kneel here before a long voyage and swear an oath to the Tide: a gift taken, a price paid, for as long as the oath holds. Only one of your company may be bound at a time.
swornText: The salt on the stones remembers your oath. The Tide will loosen it, for a price.

oaths.name: Oath of the Undertow
oaths.vow: Strike like the sea, and rest like the drowned.

oaths.name: Oath of the Breakwater
oaths.vow: Stand like the harbour wall, and strike as slowly.

oaths.name: Oath of the Gale
oaths.vow: Find the gap in every hull, and never mend your own.
